title: Quick Demo Quiz (All Features)
description: Short showcase quiz featuring all question types, offline media, EN translation, and Final Round Jokers.
rules: Standard questions award 1,000 base points + up to 200 speed bonus (decays after a 5s reading grace period).
Open text answers forgive small typos and accents; the host can also award half points.
Final Round questions award double points (2,000) and each team has 2 Jokers to activate before submitting.
A Joker doubles your winnings (2×), while a wrong answer deducts half the base points (-1,000).

1.title: Warm-up & Multimedia
1.description: 4 demo questions: multiple choice, audio clip, image, and ordering.

2.title: Pub & Czech Culture
2.description: 4 questions about beer heritage, cities, and literature.

3.title: Final Showdown (2× Joker)
3.description: 4 double-point finale questions! Use your 2 Jokers wisely.

task-pripitek.description: The team composes an original rhyming toast and delivers it to the host and room.

d1-q2.correctAnswer: Ludwig van Beethoven – Ode to Joy (9th Symphony)

d1-q3.hostNote: Designed by architect Karel Hubáček, completed in 1973.
